messages:
Mira Patel: quick heads-up — entitlement metrics gate tripped for prod:admins at ~09:12 UTC. Spike in token usage from svcacct-analytics. :eyes:
Samir Khan: any idea what changed? KMS or role bindings?
Mira Patel: audit-bot flagged a cross-account KMS grant created 09:07. see audit snippet below
audit-bot: Alert: entitlement-metrics-gate (prod:admins) triggered. anomaly_score=8.2, users_affected=12. EventID=evt_1728394001. Link: https://logs.redwood/internal/evt/1728394001
Lucy H.: pulling audit logs now. grabbing iam:bind and kms:CreateGrant around that window.
Lucy H.: found grant by service-account svcacct-analytics@infra. Binding note: principals=["analytics-collector@partner:svc"]. timestamp=2024-05-14T09:07:12Z
Samir Khan: that partner principal shouldn't have admin perms. can we revoke and rollback?
Oncall Jamie: recommend following rollback runbook step 2.a -> remove grant + set temp deny, rotate key if needed. Quick commands:
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding my-key \
  --member='serviceAccount:analytics-collector@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```
Infra Ops: we also need to check if the key was used to decrypt anything sensitive — check access_log: `kms_access_logs filter key=my-key time>09:00`
Mira Patel: opened ticket SSEC-7213, added labels: incident, entitlement, kms. Assigning Samir, Lucy, Jamie. Also add to next week's access-review heatmap.
Samir Khan: I'll revoke the binding now and start key rotation. ping when done.
Lucy H.: revocation done 09:15 UTC. rotation queued.
Oncall Jamie: ran smoke checks, no downstream failures observed. :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: great. next steps: add to periodic least-privilege audit to confirm partner bindings across orgs, and add an alert to the entitlement gate to include KMS grant diffs. filing followup doc.
Infra Ops: noted — I'll add the KMS-grant diff to the gate payload and emit a separate alert channel.
Mira Patel: thanks team. closing thread after followups posted in SSEC-7213. :lock:
